text: That night you bunk down in an old train car at the edge of the scrap heaps, with Kit in the bunk across from you.

speaker: Narrator
text: Far away, the great blue crystal on top of the Relay Tower flickers. Dark. Bright. Dark again, like a light about to go out.

beat: Kit fixes the tower crystal at night
speaker: Narrator
text: Kit sits bolt upright. "No. No, no, no," he whispers. You hear his toolbelt clink, then the door clicks shut.

beat: Kit fixes the tower crystal at night
speaker: Narrator
text: Later you wake up. Kit's bunk is empty. At the very top of the tower, a tiny white light is spitting sparks. Someone up there is welding.

beat: Kit fixes the tower crystal at night
speaker: Narrator
text: By morning Kit is fast asleep with his goggles on and a smudge of soot on his cheek. The tower crystal glows a steady, perfect blue.

speaker: Kit
text: Couldn't sleep. Went for a walk. ...Five more minutes.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: I went up to check the core this morning. It's been flickering for days, and I couldn't fix it without shutting the whole tower down.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: Yesterday it was cracked. Today it's perfect. Neatest weld I've ever seen. Kit... that was you, wasn't it?

speaker: Kit
text: Climbed all two hundred and forty rungs. But Dad, the crack was weird. Too straight. Like somebody drew it with a ruler.
